page_title: NAP 2-0 CAG | Napoli v Cagliari 23/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Napoli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
85' Substitution. Frank Anguissa will be replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
85' Cristian Stellini decides to make a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori will be replaced by Philip Billing (Napoli).
85' Here is a change. Leonardo Spinazzola is going off and Cristian Stellini gives the last tactical orders to Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giuseppe Ciocci (Cagliari) replaces Alen Sherri.
81' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Cagliari have a free kick.
79' Wow, what an escape. David Neres (Napoli) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
76' Cristian Stellini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) replacing Romelu Lukaku.
75' The referee blows his whistle as Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick is awarded to Cagliari.
74' That's the end of the game for Tommaso Augello, who is replaced by Adam Obert (Cagliari).

71' Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Napoli.
67' Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
66' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

64' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by David Neres (Napoli) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alen Sherri pulls off an easy save.
64' The corner kick from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
61' The game has come to an end for Matteo Politano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of David Neres (Napoli).
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner with a short pass.
57' Substitution. Razvan Marin (Cagliari) has come on for Antoine Makoumbou.
57' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) replaces Nicolas Viola.
57' Substitution. Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) on for Nadir Zortea.
57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico La Penna interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
52' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Federico La Penna pulls out a yellow card.
51' 2 - 0 Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alen Sherri with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
49' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' It looks like Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) saw red with that tackle. Federico La Penna won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Cagliari earn a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Federico La Penna blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The linesman raises his flag. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' 1 - 0 What an excellent finish! Scott McTominay (Napoli) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slotted the ball ino the middle of the net. Unstoppable shot!
40' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

39' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
39' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
38' The resulting corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is cleared.
38' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
35' Relief for Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

32' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari), but referee Federico La Penna must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
31' Matteo Politano (Napoli) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
31' Yellow card! It's like Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Federico La Penna agrees and books him.

28' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
26' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

25' A pass lands at the feet of Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
24' Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this. Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Scott McTominay (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Cagliari have a free kick.
20' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
18' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
15' Scott McTominay (Napoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
15' A tremendous drive by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Alen Sherri makes a brilliant save.
14' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
13' Alen Sherri comes off his line to intercept the corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli).
12' Half-chance! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Alen Sherri reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball is out of play and Napoli manage to earn a corner.
11' Great chance! Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.

10' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Alen Sherri makes a great save to stop his effort.
10' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
9' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
9' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matteo Politano (Napoli) and blew his whistle. Cagliari win a free kick.
7' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
5' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
5' Alen Sherri leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
4' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
4' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
3' Federico La Penna blows his whistle after Michel Adopo (Cagliari) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Napoli.
3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna will referee today's match.
